If you have any questions or would like to learn more about any of our education solutions or the enhancements shared, please reach out to your Relationship Manager or reply to this email. And, we hope to see you at Flywire Fusion <[[https://fusion.flywire.com/event/64962232-142e-4223-acb4-7a9cfb76b730/summary]]> this October. Register now and take advantage of our special $249 hotel rate, which is only available through the end of July.
Thanks, The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
